rows.commentary: 0.1: Mitchell Starc opens the bowling, offering no early movement as Aiden Markram watches the length delivery drift harmlessly past his off stump.
0.2: Starc attacks the channel with a sharp back-of-a-length delivery, safely absorbed into the pitch by Markram's defensive blade from the crease.
0.3: Starc completely misjudges his radar, sending down a wide full toss that Markram comfortably leaves alone.
0.4: Mitchell Starc floats one on a good length outside off, drawing Aiden Markram firmly forward into a defensive prod.
0.5: Mitchell Starc pulls his length back slightly outside off, inducing Aiden Markram to rise with the bounce and steer it away into the off side.
0.6: Starc spears it full and wide of the off stump, tempting Aiden Markram who wisely watches it sail through to the keeper without offering a stroke.
1.1: Josh Hazlewood streams in to MJ Ackerman, angling one down leg that eludes the bat while the bowler immediately bristles at a poor foothold.
1.2: Josh Hazlewood finds sharp seam movement back into MJ Ackerman, rapping the batter flush on the thigh pad from a length.
1.3: Josh Hazlewood drops it into the channel outside off stump, where MJ Ackerman leaves well alone.
1.4: Josh Hazlewood drifts a fuller delivery outside off, and MJ Ackerman takes a confident stride forward before withdrawing the bat.
1.5: Hazlewood stretches the angle wide from the crease, inviting Ackerman to watch this back-of-a-length delivery sail safely past his off stump into the keeper's gloves.
1.6: Josh Hazlewood targets the middle stump with a sharp back-of-a-length delivery, safely dead-batted by MJ Ackerman from deep inside his crease.
2.1: Mitchell Starc rushes Aiden Markram on a back-of-a-length trajectory, squaring the batsman up completely before he manages to steer it behind point with an angled bat face.
2.2: Starc swings it harmlessly wide of the channel as Markram watches it sail through to Carey.
2.3: Starc tempts him with a fuller length, forcing Markram to reach and trickle an inside edge straight to mid-off.
2.4: Mitchell Starc slides one away off a length, and Aiden Markram stands tall in his crease to dead-bat it toward point.
2.5: Mitchell Starc offers width outside off, and Aiden Markram leans forward to punch it cleanly through the cover region for four.
2.6: Mitchell Starc attacks from back of a length outside off, leaving Aiden Markram a clear path to watch it sail past.
3.1: Josh Hazlewood forces MJ Ackerman onto the back foot with a sharp delivery that angles in sharply and deflects off the inside edge into the pad.
3.2: Josh Hazlewood immediately alters his trajectory as the ball leaves the surface with subtle away movement, trapping Ackerman on the crease to softly deaden it into the off-side.
3.3: Josh Hazlewood drifts one harmlessly across the channel outside off stump, inviting MJ Ackerman to watch it sail through to the keeper.
3.4: Josh Hazlewood angles a back of a length delivery across the channel, and MJ Ackerman expertly opens the face to guide it safely toward gully.
3.5: Josh Hazlewood tests the stumps with another back of a length ball, and MJ Ackerman calmly presents a straight bat to return it to the bowler.
3.6: Josh Hazlewood targets the channel outside off, and MJ Ackerman watches the full length pass safely by with his bat lofted.
4.1: Mitchell Starc angles a back-of-a-length delivery wide of the stumps, inviting Aiden Markram to offer no stroke.
4.2: Starc hunts the stumps with a full examination, but Markram dangles his blade, squirts the inside edge behind square, and scampers back industriously for two.
4.3: Mitchell Starc drops it back in the channel, and Aiden Markram meets it beneath his eyes, dead-batting from the crease with cushioned wrists.
4.4: Mitchell Starc offers width well outside off stump, inviting Aiden Markram to watch it sail safely through to the keeper.
4.5: Mitchell Starc offers up a full delivery outside off stump, and Aiden Markram pounces instantly, striding forward to punch it cleanly through the cover region for four.
4.6: Mitchell Starc hurls it back of a length outside off, and Aiden Markram carefully tracks it straight through to the waiting gloves of the keeper for no run.
5.1: Hazlewood probes just outside the channel, and Ackerman presses forward to dead-bat the delivery into the pitch.
5.2: Hazlewood alters his angle to round the wicket, dropping a full delivery on off stump that Ackerman aggressively charges down the track to squeeze toward short mid-off.
5.3: Josh Hazlewood drops it back in the channel outside off, and MJ Ackerman opens the face to steer it wide of point for a single, marking his very first runs in Test cricket with a wave of relief.
5.4: Josh Hazlewood hurls it on a good length at off and middle, trapping Aiden Markram on his crease to bunt it straight toward mid-on.
5.5: Josh Hazlewood angles one back of a length outside off, leaving Aiden Markram to watch it sail past him untouched.
5.6: Josh Hazlewood finishes the over as Aiden Markram firmly defends the delivery straight down the pitch.
6.1: Scott Boland lands a length delivery outside off that nips away sharply and dies on its sluggish journey, reaching the keeper only on the second bounce.
6.2: Scott Boland extracts extravagant movement to comprehensively beat MJ Ackerman on the outside edge.
6.3: No run for MJ Ackerman off Scott Boland.
6.4: Scott Boland dangles the full carrot wide of off stump, drawing a desperate, swinging lunge from MJ Ackerman that only finds thin air.
6.5: Boland spears a sharp back-of-a-length delivery sharply back toward the timber, forcing Ackerman to anchor in his crease and pat it straight down the pitch.
6.6: Boland keeps the pressure dialed in, drawing a defensive clip from Ackerman through the middle and off axis directly to midwicket.
7.1: Hazlewood finds that probing length on the fourth stump line, and Markram exercises absolute discipline to shoulder arms.
7.2: Josh Hazlewood digs it in short, questioning the umpire instantly as Aiden Markram ducks underneath the lifter.
7.3: Hazlewood probes with a tight length, and Markram gently nurdles it away into the leg side to rotate the strike.
7.4: Hazlewood comes from round the wicket, targeting the channel on a short of length, and Ackerman cushions it softly right beside his shoes.
7.5: Josh Hazlewood probes a disciplined channel outside off stump, and MJ Ackerman watches it sail safely through to the keeper.
7.6: MJ Ackerman steps purposefully down the pitch, prompting Josh Hazlewood to shorten his delivery and induce a watchful defensive prod.
8.1: Boland hits that probing length wide of off-stump, inviting the stroke, but Aiden Markram wisely offers no shot and lets it sail through to the keeper.
8.2: Scott Boland locks onto a testing length around the top of off stump, drawing a compact defensive prod from Aiden Markram firmly inside his crease.
8.3: Scott Boland tightens his trajectory with a straighter line, prompting Aiden Markram to nurdle the ball softly into the midwicket sector.
8.4: Scott Boland strikes as an inside edge betrays Aiden Markram, dragging the ball back onto the timber to end a promising eleven-run stay.
8.5: Boland strikes immediately with relentless precision, finding the edge of Bedingham and Alex Carey makes no mistake behind the stumps for a first-ball duck.
8.6: Scott Boland spears a venomous nip-backer into Temba Bavuma, locking the South African deep in his crease as an inside edge abruptly silences the lbw appeals.
Scott Boland strikes again, claiming his second wicket of the over to leave RSA reeling!
9.1: Josh Hazlewood targets the hips, allowing MJ Ackerman to flick the ball away toward fine leg for a single.
9.2: Josh Hazlewood digs it in back of a length on off and middle, and Temba Bavuma stays back to dead-bat it down.
9.3: Josh Hazlewood persists on a probing good length in the channel, leaving Temba Bavuma with nothing to play at.
9.4: Hazlewood bangs it in from back of a length and gets it to rear sharply off the surface, catching the bottom glove of a hopping Bavuma.
9.5: Hazlewood lands this one on a good length outside the off stump, and Bavuma offers no stroke to let it pass through.
9.6: Josh Hazlewood finds a testing good length outside off, and Temba Bavuma stays put to dead-bat it firmly towards the mid-off fielder.
10.1: Boland targets the corridor on a good length, clipping the high shoulder of Ackerman's defensive bat to squirt a single away past point.
10.2: Boland finds his length again, and Bavuma stays firmly on the crease with hands tucked in close to dead-bat the delivery into the off-side.
10.3: Boland steams in and produces an absolute snorter that zips past Bavuma's defensive prod without a touch.
10.4: Scott Boland locks onto the stumps with a full delivery, and Temba Bavuma remains glued to his crease, sending a thick edge squirting past gully to the boundary.
10.5: No run for Temba Bavuma off Scott Boland.
10.6: Boland targets the top of off stump on a good length, met by the soft-handed defense of Bavuma straight into the hands of mid-off.
11.1: Cummins drops it on a good length around off, drawing Ackerman forward to drive the ball toward mid-on.
11.2: MJ Ackerman does not score off Pat Cummins.
11.3: Pat Cummins searches for the pads, spraying it down the leg-side as MJ Ackerman shapes to glance it away but finds only thin air.
11.4: Pat Cummins digs it in short down the leg side, jamming MJ Ackerman on the pull and forcing a hurried glove past the diving wicketkeeper for a pair.
11.5: Pat Cummins releases a sharp delivery from round the wicket, pinning MJ Ackerman as the bottom hand instinctively releases off the handle.
11.6: Pat Cummins maintains the pressure on a back of a length outside off, safely smothered from the crease by MJ Ackerman.
12.1: Scott Boland relentlessly targets that probing good length, nipping it back into off-stump as Temba Bavuma releases his bottom hand to dead-bat it straight into the turf.
12.2: Scott Boland lands one on a probing length in the corridor of uncertainty, whistling right past the outside edge of Temba Bavuma's tentative blade.
21.6: Mitchell Starc lands it on a length and nips it in, allowing Ryan Rickelton to anchor deep in his crease and nudge it gently toward the leg side.
22.1: Scott Boland attacks the stumps on a fullish length, forcing Temba Bavuma to bring his bat straight down as the ball trickles away to the right of the bowler.
22.2: Scott Boland delivers a 133kph ball from just back of a length that holds its line outside off, prompting a stylish leave from Temba Bavuma.
22.3: Scott Boland digs it short outside off, and Temba Bavuma uncorks a fierce swipe that meets nothing but thin air.
22.4: Scott Boland angles one into the body from a shortish length, allowing Temba Bavuma to turn his bat face and deflect it toward square leg for a comfortable single.
22.5: Scott Boland dangles a full teaser outside off, but Ryan Rickelton covers his stumps by moving his left leg across and watches it sail through to the keeper.
22.6: Scott Boland comes from round the wicket to send down a 134.4kph slanting length delivery, which Ryan Rickelton defends soundly right beneath his eyes towards mid-on.
23.1: Mitchell Starc steams in at 147.6kph on a full line close to off, and Temba Bavuma pushes it into the covers before rightfully aborting a hasty single.
23.2: Mitchell Starc fires it across the right-hander at 141kph, but Temba Bavuma shows no interest in the wide offering and lets it go.
23.3: Mitchell Starc clocks 148.9kph with a half-volley outside off, and Temba Bavuma relies on pure hand-eye coordination to reach out and lace it through the cover region for a boundary.
23.4: Mitchell Starc drops it short and wide outside off at 142kph, leaving Temba Bavuma entirely unbothered as he ignores the delivery.
23.5: Mitchell Starc ramps the pace up to 149.5kph from round the wicket on a good length outside off, watching as Temba Bavuma refuses to engage and lets it through to the keeper.
23.6: Mitchell Starc unleashes a 146.7kph thunderbolt, full and wide, watching Temba Bavuma ignore it completely as it carries safely to the gloves.
24.1: Scott Boland angles one away from a short length, inviting Ryan Rickelton to cushion it gently toward the covers with delicate hands.
24.2: Scott Boland slips a fuller delivery in around off, prompting Ryan Rickelton to crouch low and punch the ball straight to mid-off.
24.3: Scott Boland tightens his line and length right on the batsman, leaving Ryan Rickelton to dead-bat the ball solidly toward mid-off.
24.4: Scott Boland swings round the wicket targeting that probing fourth-stump corridor, allowing Ryan Rickelton to guide it softly toward mid-on.
24.5: Scott Boland pivots over the wicket once more, angling a fullish delivery across the right-hander's off stump as Ryan Rickelton stands his ground.
34.4: Scott Boland serves up a gentle delivery angling into off stump, which Ryan Rickelton solidly gets behind to block.
34.5: Scott Boland tempts Ryan Rickelton with a fuller ball outside off that nips away, drawing a thick edge through backward point for a couple of runs.
34.6: Scott Boland attacks the sixth stump line with a good length delivery that Ryan Rickelton wisely leaves alone.
35.1: Pat Cummins digs it in hard on a short of length, allowing Temba Bavuma to tap it from the crease in front of mid-off for a quick single.
35.2: Pat Cummins targets down leg on a short of length, forcing Ryan Rickelton to expertly keep it down as he tucks it behind square.
35.3: Pat Cummins pitches in the channel on a good length, offering Temba Bavuma an easy leave.
35.4: Pat Cummins drops a bouncer over the left shoulder, and Temba Bavuma swivels to hook it all the way over the fine leg boundary.
35.5: Pat Cummins targets the channel on a back of a length, and Temba Bavuma watches it pass safely.
35.6: Pat Cummins targets the top of off on a good length, prompting Temba Bavuma to prod forward in defense.
36.1: Scott Boland comes round the wicket to angle a length ball at the stumps, which Ryan Rickelton safely defends from the crease.
36.2: Scott Boland attacks the channel on a good length, and Ryan Rickelton shuffles across to dead-bat it.
36.3: Scott Boland finds a healthy edge off a good length delivery that straightens against the angle, sending the ball rolling past second slip for four.
36.4: Boland targets the back of a length with an inward angle, and Rickelton stays back to absorb it solidly in defense.
36.5: Boland keeps it back of a length outside off, and Rickelton rides the bounce to gently nudge a quick single into the off side.
36.6: Boland probes the channel on a good length as Bavuma flashes past the outside edge before pulling his bat away.
37.1: Cummins serves up a full length just outside off, handled cleanly by Rickelton toward mid-off.
37.2: Cummins hammers away on a back-of-a-length trajectory within the channel.
40.2: Mitchell Starc drops it on a good length right at the stumps, and Wiaan Mulder lets it arrive before dead-batting it straight down the pitch.
40.3: Mitchell Starc pushes slightly fuller outside off, prompting a forward stride and a textbook defensive prod from Wiaan Mulder.
40.4: Mitchell Starc attacks from just back of a length around middle and off, where Wiaan Mulder hangs back to meet it with the full face.
40.5: Mitchell Starc unleashes a lethal nip-backer that squares up Wiaan Mulder completely, zipping past the outside edge and straight through to the keeper.
40.6: Mitchell Starc drifts down the leg-side, allowing Wiaan Mulder to clip it behind square and scramble frantically for a breathless second run.
41.1: Scott Boland probes the channel on a good length, and Temba Bavuma watches it sail safely through.
41.2: Scott Boland angles one in fuller than a length, catching Temba Bavuma via an inside edge straight onto the pad.
41.3: Scott Boland targets the stumps with a length delivery that nips back sharply, met safely from the crease by Wiaan Mulder.
41.4: Scott Boland delivers from back of a length around off, easily blocked right from the crease by Wiaan Mulder.
41.5: Scott Boland hits a good length on middle, and Wiaan Mulder positions his bat firmly in front of the pad to defend.
41.6: Scott Boland tempts Wiaan Mulder into a drive on a deceptive length, inducing an inside-half shank back down the pitch.
42.1: Mitchell Starc angles a delivery away outside off, leaving Temba Bavuma a completely straightforward leave.
42.2: Mitchell Starc hurls a length delivery across off stump, and Temba Bavuma stays back in his crease to tap it into the cover region for a single.
42.3: Mitchell Starc tests Wiaan Mulder with a packed cordon of three slips and two gullies, zipping a length ball past the outside edge as the batsman is drawn forward.
42.4: Mitchell Starc fires one wider outside the off stump, and Wiaan Mulder offers an easy leave.
42.5: Mitchell Starc switches over the wicket to pitch it up outside off, meeting a forward defensive punch straight to mid-off from Wiaan Mulder.
42.6: Mitchell Starc digs a short ball into the channel that Wiaan Mulder ducks beneath, bringing a close to Day 2 with Australia holding the upper hand.
